title: Waypoint Explorer
summary: Discover return destinations and earn the Explorer title.
body:
Waypoint crystals — not released

A glowing crystal with the existing a waypoint label is prepared for testing. It adds a model to the current portal effect so the marker is intended to remain recognizable when spell particles are reduced. This needs a paired launcher update and server activation; it is not live yet. Appearance in both model modes and with particles off still needs in-game testing. Locations, discovery and return destinations stay the same.

Explore the world, unlock return destinations, and earn a title.

  • Start: Approach a marker named a waypoint. The Waypoint Master in the tunnel explains your progress.
  • Goal: Discover every waypoint shown in your current progress by approaching its marker.
  • Rewards: Each discovery unlocks a return destination with the Waypoint Master. Completing the current catalog unlocks the title the Explorer.
  • How it tracks: Discoveries are saved per character. Progress is tracked through discovery and NPC dialogue.

See the tunnel guide for services and travel options for your next destination.

Recognize the portal and Keeper

The waypoint uses a portal effect. A nearby small floating eye is the separate Instance Keeper. At Unrest, the portal and recall destination are beside the entrance Keeper at /loc -38, 52, 3.
sources: docs/ops/waypoint-crystal-20261022/README.md; source/build candidate only, no publication or native visual acceptance
